title: Share of the Late Fees Standing Taken With a Granite Ridge Pass Account Presentation
content:
The share at which the late fees standing on a Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme pass account are taken with a presentation turns on the refusals the account carries in the three whole months ending on the handling date.

| Refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date | Share of the late fees standing that is taken |
| --- | --- |
| at least as many as the number of refusals the tier tolerates before privileges are reviewed | the whole of them, a share of 100 per cent |
| at least 2, but fewer than the number the tier tolerates | half of them, a share of 50 per cent |
| any other position | no share is taken by this rule |

**First.** Where the pass account carries at least as many refusals in the three whole months ending on the handling date as the number of refusals the tier tolerates before privileges are reviewed, the late fees standing are taken in full.

**Second.** Where the pass account carries at least 2 refusals in that window but fewer than the number the tier tolerates, half of the late fees standing is taken.

**Otherwise.** In any other case this rule takes no share of the late fees standing.

### Worked on the tiers' own tolerances

A Granite Ridge Midweek Pass tolerates 2 refusals before privileges are reviewed; a Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass tolerates 4.

| Tier | Refusals in the window | Share taken |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 2 | 100 per cent, the tolerance of 2 being reached |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | 1 | none, being below both 2 and the tolerance |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 2 | 50 per cent, being at least 2 and below the tolerance of 4 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | 4 | 100 per cent |

The two conditions never overlap: the second is reached only below the tier's tolerance, and on a tier that tolerates 2 the first condition is met at the same count that would otherwise open the second.
